_comment: Template for a site's field gateway. Copy this to gateway.json beside it,
fill in the three values marked CHANGE ME, and keep the copy out of
version control — it holds a device credential. *.json is gitignored, so
a copy here is already excluded; a copy anywhere else is not.
Every key is documented in FIELD_GATEWAY.md. The gateway refuses to start
on a config it cannot honour, and names the key at fault.
_comment_api_url: The platform's address alone. The gateway appends the endpoint path
itself, so a path here is refused at startup rather than 404ing on every
sweep — a 404 is retried as a transient failure, which is a bad way to
https://api.nexucon.net for a machine at the site. http://web:8000 when
the gateway runs as the compose service on the platform itself, where it
talks to gunicorn directly and never leaves the host.
_comment_device_token: CHANGE ME. A device credential (nxdev_...) issued by an officer for THIS
instrument. Not the instrument's serial number, and not a login token.
Issue one from the platform: POST /api/v1/telemetry/device-tokens/ with
the device's id. The plaintext is shown once and cannot be recovered.
_comment_device: CHANGE ME. The platform's UUID for this instrument's FieldDevice row —
not the serial printed on the unit. The credential above and this id must
belong to the same row; a mismatch is refused rather than corrected.
_comment_project: Optional. The platform UUID of the project captures land on. Left out, the device's assigned project is used.
_comment_watch_dir: CHANGE ME. The folder the instrument exports into — most often the synced
folder (OneDrive/Dropbox/share) the export is saved to. Use doubled
backslashes in JSON, and keep the folder free of anything that is not an
export: every *.csv and *.json in it will be sent.
_comment_data_type: Only 'pundit' has a file contract that describes a whole capture. Leave it.
_comment_context: Optional. Values the platform applies to every reading the gateway sends,
for an instrument whose export carries no structural element or test type
of its own. A value already in the file wins over the one here.
_comment_patterns: Optional. Which files in the folder are exports. Narrow this if the folder holds anything else.
_comment_settle_seconds: How long a file's size and timestamp must hold still before it is sent. Raise it on a slow link.
_comment_interval_seconds: How often the folder is checked.
_comment_timeout_seconds: How long to wait on the platform before treating the attempt as failed and retrying later.
_comment_wait_for_watch_dir: Leave false for a folder that is always there — a OneDrive folder or a
permanent share — where a missing folder means watch_dir is wrong and you
want to be told. Set true for a folder that comes and goes: a USB stick
unplugged between visits, or a share that is not always mounted. The
gateway then waits for it to appear instead of stopping.
This matters under Task Scheduler. A task that stops is restarted, and
the documented 'restart every 1 minute, up to 999 times' budget is spent
in about 17 hours — after which the task is dead until someone notices.
